gamemechanicinfo-coinage-text:
Planchets
The first step to minting your own coins is to create a coin punch. rightmouse click with the punch to begin creating a shape for your coins. Once your punch is ready, use it together with metal plates to create planchets.

Minting
Create custom coin designs by rightmouse clicking with a Trussell. Hold the trussell and a hammer, place your planchets in a coining pile together with an anvil die, and rightmouse click the pile to mint coins.

Remember to copy your design to a new trussell before the original breaks! Place a blank trussell in the coining pile, hold the old one, and hammer the design in.
Your coin punch can be similarly copied by crafting it together with a blank one.
